name: Salis
description: A student of Perisophia who raises the story of Matatios.

timeline.summary: Salis raises the story of Matatios, and Perisophia warns that Matatios only met himself and did not become aware of himself.
timeline.quote: Matatios did not become aware of himself, he only met himself.

pages_say.description: A student of Perisophia who raises the story of Matatios.
